description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter (BannerAdapter) for displaying full-width banner cards in an Android app. It manages banner items, applies diffing for efficient updates, and handles binding views including image loading and focus animations.

classes.name: BannerAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for banner items with focus animations and diffing for efficient list updates.

methods.name: BannerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a list of BannerItem objects.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a BannerVH (ViewHolder) for an item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a BannerItem to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

inner_classes.name: BannerVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class managing the banner item view, including focus handling and image binding.

methods.name: BannerVH
methods.description: Initializes view holder, sets focus change animations, and style.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a BannerItem, sets content description, loads image, and sets focus styles.

methods.name: BannerDiff.areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two BannerItems are the same based on their id.

methods.name: BannerDiff.areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the contents of two BannerItems are the same.
